note: Where a mod's code and data may sit in the mod area. Offsets are from the start of the mod area (RAM 0x46000000). Ranges are [start, end). Keep this file in step with the packages in the repo.

delay-control.note: From mods/delay-control/make_features.py: the registration words at 0x4000 and 0x4004 and the fixed header (dc.h, 12 bytes, DC_VIEW at 0x4008), then the PACKAGES ranges, the last of which ends at 0x6e00. 0x6e00 is already a multiple of 0x100, so it is not rounded further.

dev.note: 8 KB for development. Clear of DelayCtrl (from 0x4000). The older non-package mods used 0x0000 to 0x2000 and 0x7e00 and up; they are not part of the package system, so the dev slot avoids both.
